title: KP symbolic manipulation animation library v0 loop
summary: Approved candidate loop for expanding KP into a typed symbolic manipulation animation library across algebra, calculus, linear algebra, and graphical equivalents.

sourceRefs.summary: Accepted long-term plan for major symbolic manipulation animation families.
Theseus decision node that makes symbolic manipulation animation-library expansion the current long-term KP direction.
Roadmap active focus and near-term priorities for symbolic manipulation family expansion.
Semantic runtime thread describing how symbolic manipulation families should use existing semantic asset, runtime-frame, visual-frame, graph, dashboard, generated problem, and flashcard protocols.
AnimationAsset container and timeline/render-target contracts that symbolic manipulation families should use.
SemanticTransformation contract for symbolic manipulation definitions, correspondence, laws, and provenance.

allowedWork: Only work on the approved symbolic manipulation animation-library slices.

Model reusable semantic animation asset families with SemanticTransformation definitions, correspondence, identity rules, visual motifs, runtime-frame samples, visual-frame samples, graph equivalents, generated problem hooks, flashcard hooks, law checks, and dashboard rows.
Use deterministic fixtures and existing KP asset/runtime/rendering contracts.
Commit after each verified slice and record Theseus evidence.
disallowedWork: Do not build a full CAS or theorem prover in this loop.
Do not add GIF/video encoders, live LSP, network integrations, or dynamic package loading in this loop.
Do not make graph views a separate animation system; graph equivalents must project from the same semantic assets where honest.
Do not broaden into unrelated dashboard redesign or visual polish beyond what the active slice requires.
Do not stage unrelated dirty worktree files.
goal: Build the first representative symbolic manipulation animation library so algebra, calculus, linear algebra, and graph-equivalent transformations become typed, searchable, composable KP animation assets.
stopConditions: Stop if a slice requires a broad renderer rewrite instead of extending the existing AnimationAsset, SemanticTransformation, runtime-frame, or visual-frame path.
Stop if verification fails and the fix is not local to the active slice.
Stop if work requires a full CAS, theorem prover, GIF/video encoder, live LSP, network integration, dynamic package loading, or unrelated dashboard redesign.
Stop when the approved slice list is exhausted.

slices.title: Define symbolic manipulation family schema
slices.summary: Create the shared typed shape for a manipulation family: semantic objects/selectors, transformations, correspondence, motifs, samples, graph equivalents, generated problem hooks, flashcard hooks, laws, and dashboard metadata.

slices.title: Add symbolic family registry and dashboard rows
slices.summary: Create a registry and dashboard projection so every family is searchable, comparable, and visible before individual coverage expands.

slices.title: Add algebra both-sides operation family
slices.summary: Model add, subtract, multiply, and divide both sides with identity persistence, inverse provenance, generated fixture hooks, and a basic visual sample.

slices.title: Add cancellation and combine-like-terms families
slices.summary: Promote cancellation and combine-like-terms as reusable algebra families with correspondence and reversible visual motif coverage.

slices.title: Add distribution and factoring family
slices.summary: Model distribution and factoring as inverse-ish semantic transformations with explicit correspondence for copied, grouped, and artifact tokens.

slices.title: Add fraction simplification family
slices.summary: Cover split, merge, simplify, common-denominator, and reciprocal forms while preserving numerator, denominator, fraction bar, and artifact semantics.

slices.title: Add exponent and logarithm law family
slices.summary: Model power, root, exponent/log inverse, product/quotient powers, and function-wrapped rewrites with persistent base/argument semantics.

slices.title: Add inequality transformation family
slices.summary: Model inequality-preserving operations and sign-flip cases with explicit law metadata so invalid transforms are not animated as valid.

slices.title: Attach algebra generated problem hooks
slices.summary: Connect the algebra families to generated problem fixtures, solution steps, flashcard hooks, and dashboard family maturity rows.

slices.title: Add calculus derivative rules family
slices.summary: Model sum, constant multiple, power, product, quotient, and chain rule transforms as semantic animation families with reusable visual samples.

slices.title: Add derivative tangent graph equivalent
slices.summary: Project derivative family assets into graph samples where derivative semantics appear as tangent/local-slope visual equivalents.

slices.title: Add integral and FTC family
slices.summary: Model antiderivative, definite integral, bounds, and Fundamental Theorem of Calculus rewrites with persistent integrand/bound semantics.

slices.title: Add integral area graph equivalent
slices.summary: Project integral families into area accumulation graph samples with provenance and honest sampled-vs-symbolic metadata.

slices.title: Add Taylor and local linearization family
slices.summary: Model Taylor expansion, truncation, remainder annotation, and local linear approximation as symbolic families with graph equivalents.

slices.title: Add gradient and Jacobian family
slices.summary: Model scalar gradient and vector-valued Jacobian forms with symbolic, matrix, and local-linear-map views.

slices.title: Add Hessian and optimization family
slices.summary: Model Hessian, quadratic form, second-derivative test, and optimization stationarity examples with curvature-oriented graph equivalents.

slices.title: Add vector add and scale family
slices.summary: Model vector addition, scalar multiplication, component persistence, and graphical vector composition.

slices.title: Add dot product and projection family
slices.summary: Model dot products, projections, orthogonality, and angle/length interpretations with symbolic and graphical views.

slices.title: Add matrix-vector family
slices.summary: Model matrix-vector multiplication as row dot products with persistent entries and graph linear-map equivalents.

slices.title: Add matrix-matrix composition family
slices.summary: Model matrix multiplication as composed dot products and test higher-order animation composition.

slices.title: Add row operations family
slices.summary: Model row swap, scale, and row replacement with provenance, determinant impact metadata, and equation-system equivalents.

slices.title: Add determinant and inverse family
slices.summary: Model determinant as area/volume scaling and inverse as undoing a linear map with symbolic and graph samples.

slices.title: Add basis change and eigen family
slices.summary: Model basis changes, coordinate transforms, eigenvectors, eigenvalues, and diagonalization starter examples.

slices.title: Add graph equivalence law suite
slices.summary: Add law checks that representation transforms preserve semantic references, correspondence, rewind, and honest sampled graph metadata.

slices.title: Add flashcard hooks for symbolic families
slices.summary: Project selected family assets into cloze, focus, predict-next, and relationship prompt hooks without duplicating lesson markup.

slices.title: Add paused-frame drill-down for symbolic families
slices.summary: Expose paused-frame transformation context so an author or LLM can decompose confusing steps into smaller animations.

slices.title: Update dashboard search and progress rows
slices.summary: Surface symbolic family coverage, readiness, blockers, law status, graph equivalents, generated problem hooks, and flashcard hooks in the project dashboard.

slices.title: Close symbolic manipulation library loop
slices.summary: Write the closeout report with completed commits, verification evidence, residual risks, and recommended next slices.
